title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: The Eagle Has Landed
description: A Nazi colonel (Robert Duvall) drops a colonel (Michael Caine), a task force and an Irishman (Donald Sutherland) into England to kidnap Winston Churchill.

title: A Better Tomorrow III
description: Cheung meets a beautiful gang-leader while trying to bring his family from wartime Saigon to Hong Kong.

title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
description: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.

title: Creepshow 2
description: A vengeful cigar-store Indian, a flesh-eating creature and a hitchhiker who won't stay dead populate a trilogy of terror.

title: Chopper
description: A maximum security inmate (Eric Bana), serving time for kidnapping a judge, becomes a target when he stabs another prisoner.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
description: Underhanded real estate salesmen sink to varying levels of deceit in order to sell their dubious properties.

title: The Kid
description: The Little Tramp (Charlie Chaplin) raises the abandoned child (Jack Coogan) of an unwed mother (Edna Purviance).

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Sonny
description: Out of the Army, a man resumes his job as a gigolo in New Orleans and meets a call-girl who works for his mother.

title: Labyrinth
description: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

title: Gerry
description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water.

title: The Dark Crystal
description: Two elfin beings search for the missing shard to an all-powerful crystal that can save their world from evil.

title: Donnie Darko
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: The Heart of Me
description: A woman (Helena Bonham Carter) has an affair with her older sister's (Olivia Williams) husband (Paul Bettany) and bears his child.

title: The Ticket
description: After a sightless man suddenly regains his vision, he is blinded by his obsession with the superficial.

title: Good Fences
description: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.

title: Death on the Nile
description: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov), solves the shipboard murder of an American heiress.

title: The Killer Meteors
description: A powerful man seeks help from a local hero (Jackie Chan) whose secret weapon makes him invincible.
An Italian film director (Marcello Mastroianni) seeking the meaning of life retreats from his wife (Anouk Aimée), mistress and flatterers.

title: Sliding Doors
description: After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.

title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
description: In 18th-century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent to the Gevaudan province at the king's behest to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

title: The Boys From Brazil
description: An old Nazi-hunter (Laurence Olivier) finds Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) and a cohort (James Mason) in the jungle, cloning Hitler for the Fourth Reich.

title: White Zombie
description: A plantation owner takes the help of a voodoo master to lure an innocent woman, even though she loves someone else.

title: Take Me to the River
description: Music legends from Stax Records and Memphis mentor and pass on their musical knowledge to contemporary artists.

title: Sharkansas Women's Prison Massacre
description: Five escaped prisoners (Dominique Swain, Cindy Lucas) use their guns and wits to battle prehistoric sharks that attack on land.

title: City Hunter
description: U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.

title: Affliction
description: A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).

title: Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

title: Eraserhead
description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

title: Silent House
description: Horrifying events turn panic to real terror when a young woman (Elizabeth Olsen) becomes trapped in the old house she's helping her father and uncle renovate.

title: House
description: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion, where supernatural events occur almost immediately.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Black Sabbath
description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: Funny Games
description: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

title: Night of the Demons
description: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

title: Inland Empire
description: Two actors (Laura Dern, Justin Theroux) star in a remake of a film which was originally unfinished because its leads were murdered.

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
description: While visiting an excavation site in Kenya, a former priest sees signs of demonic possession.
